name: python-sse-api
title: Python SSE service
blurb: Server-sent events on FastAPI: an endless response, resume with Last-Event-ID, a proxy-proof content type, and a socket test that proves the body is not buffered
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing && uv pip install -e . pytest httpx ruff

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --quiet --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --quiet --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest httpx ruff

verify.name: http
verify.cmd:
set -e
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5454/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "port 5454 is already answering - stop that process before running this step" >&2
  exit 1
fi
.venv/bin/uvicorn {{ package_name }}.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5454 --log-level warning >.sse-http.log 2>&1 &
server=$!
trap 'kill -TERM -"$server" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; for _ in $(seq 1 20); do kill -0 $server 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.1; done; kill -KILL $server 2>/dev/null || true; wait $server 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for _ in $(seq 1 200); do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5454/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 0.25
done
kill -0 $server
expect() {
  case "$3" in
    *"$2"*) echo "ok $1" ;;
    *) echo "FAIL $1: want *$2* in: $3"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
}
expect health '"status":"ok"' "$(curl -sS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:5454/health)"
stream=$(curl -sS -N --max-time 10 "http://127.0.0.1:5454/stream?count=4&delay=0.2")
expect tick_ids 'id: 4' "$stream"
expect done_event '"ticks":4' "$stream"
expect not_buffered 'event: tick' "$stream"
resumed=$(curl -sS -N --max-time 10 -H 'Last-Event-ID: 2' "http://127.0.0.1:5454/stream?count=4&delay=0")
expect resume_starts_at_3 'id: 3' "$resumed"
case "$resumed" in *"id: 1"*) echo "FAIL resume replayed from the start"; exit 1;; esac
echo "ok resume does not replay"
# Reading the socket line by line is the only honest way to time the first event:
# curl piped into grep reports the end of the pipe, not the arrival of the line.
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import http.client
import time

connection = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", 5454, timeout=10)
started = time.time()
connection.request("GET", "/stream?count=3&delay=0.4")
response = connection.getresponse()
first = None
events = 0
while True:
    line = response.fp.readline()
    if not line:
        break
    text = line.decode()
    if text.startswith("event: tick"):
        events += 1
        if first is None:
            first = time.time() - started
    if text.startswith("event: done"):
        break
assert events == 3, events
assert first is not None and first < 0.35, first
print("ok first event arrived in %.0fms, %d ticks" % (first * 1000, events))
PY
stats=$(curl -sS -N --max-time 10 "http://127.0.0.1:5454/stats/stream?text=a%20b%0Ac&size=2&delay=0")
expect stats_chunks 'event: chunk' "$stats"
expect stats_totals '"lines":1,"words":3,"bytes":5' "$stats"
expect invalid 'invalid_request' "$(curl -sS --max-time 5 'http://127.0.0.1:5454/stream?count=0')"
expect not_found '"error":"not_found","detail":"no route for GET /nope"' "$(curl -sS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:5454/nope)"
expect wrong_method 'method_not_allowed' "$(curl -sS --max-time 5 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:5454/health)"
expect post_stream 'does not stream' "$(curl -sS --max-time 5 -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"count":1}' http://127.0.0.1:5454/stream)"
